title: Design and Evaluation of Novel Selective BET BD2 Inhibitors by Combining QSAR, Molecular Docking and Molecular Dynamics Simulation Techniques.
authors: Tong, Jian-Bo; Sun, Yue; Chang, Ze-Lei; Zhang, Ya-Kun; Xing, Xiao-Yu; Yan, Jing; Li, Jia-Le
one_liner_zh: 该文聚焦BET蛋白BD2小分子抑制剂设计，采用QSAR、分子对接和MD模拟，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: Bromodomain and extra terminal domain (BET) proteins play important roles in biological processes, such as cell proliferation, differentiation, and signaling, and are involved in the occurrence and development of many diseases, including cancer and inflammatory diseases. Selective inhibitors targeting the first bromodomain (BD1) or the second bromodomain (BD2) have triggered a new wave of research to produce more specific and safer drugs. In this study, 37 novel selective BET BD2 inhibitors with anti-inflammatory activity are selected to construct robust Topomer CoMFA (q(2) = 0.689, r(2) = 0.916) and HQSAR (q(2) = 0.805, r(2) = 0.906) models, and both models have good external prediction ability. On the basis of quantitative structure-activity relationship (QSAR) results and ZINC15 database screening, 23 new compounds with ideal inhibitory activity are successfully designed. The stability and feasibility of binding the newly designed compounds to the target protein are further verified by molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulation validation. In conclusion, this work not only provides a reliable QSAR model as a screening tool for future anti-inflammatory drug development but also provides a theoretical basis for the design and modification of subsequent selective BET BD2 inhibitors.
abstract_zh: 溴结构域和末端外结构域（BET）蛋白在细胞增殖、分化及信号传导等生物过程中发挥重要作用，并参与包括癌症和炎症性疾病在内的多种疾病的发生与发展。针对第一溴结构域（BD1）或第二溴结构域（BD2）的选择性抑制剂已引发新一轮研究浪潮，旨在开发更具特异性和更安全的药物。本研究选取37种具有抗炎活性的新型选择性BET BD2抑制剂，构建了稳健的Topomer CoMFA（q(2) = 0.689, r(2) = 0.916）和HQSAR（q(2) = 0.805, r(2) = 0.906）模型，两种模型均展现出良好的外部预测能力。基于定量构效关系（QSAR）结果及ZINC15数据库筛选，成功设计了23种具有理想抑制活性的新化合物。通过分子对接和分子动力学模拟验证，进一步确认了新设计化合物与靶蛋白结合的稳定性和可行性。总之，本研究不仅为未来抗炎药物开发提供了可靠的QSAR模型作为筛选工具，也为后续选择性BET BD2抑制剂的设计与修饰提供了理论基础。
